content: Ngọhkha s'Ibinọkpaabyi ọnangi Mosẹs
Mẹ wọ, Mosẹs obhina bi, “Kaam ńsi yan, idikha bẹ ani kaam k'odik-ọkka atzọk, bẹ itzọhng kabira ayonga anang-m, bẹ an-aben bi, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi kọ abẹ koyini khi?”
Mẹ wọ, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọbọbh-ẹ bi, “Mbọng vọ fa kọ atzim k'ọbọhk kwọ o?” Mosẹs obhina bi, “Ochikhura e.”
Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi oben-ẹ bi, “Kọ bhari ochikhura nwuma k'irerek.” Mosẹs ọbhari chẹ k'irek, ochikhura nwa oreng jọhk, Mosẹs ọrọbh oji chẹ.
Mẹ wọ, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi oben-ẹ bi, “Nemi ọbọhk kwọ abọkha jọhk nda k'ẹsara.” Mẹ wọ, Mosẹs onemi ọbọhk ọbọkha jọhk nda k'ẹsara, jọhk en-ebiri ẹbhakhi ochikhura k'ọbọhk kwẹ.
Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi oben bi, “Si mando, ifha bẹ akhera bi, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi kw'abatte Abraham, ọmaana Isaak, ttara Jekọb akpobh, ọkk'ọ abẹ oyina.”
Mẹ wọ e, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi obiro oben bi, “Kọ khe ọbọhk kwọ k'ọphaangi kw'ittemmọma kw'ọnọhma-baba kwọ ẹtzaanga.” Mosẹs osi mando. Mada ọn-ọrọbh ọbọhk, ọbọhk on-ode okkim-okkima kw'owuri bi gwaang.
“Kọ biri kpa nnam akhe ọbọhk kwọ k'ọphaangi kw'ittemmọma kw'ọnọhma-baba kwọ ẹtzaanga.” Mosẹs osi mando. Mada ọn-ọrọbh ọbọhk, ọbọhk on-obiro ọkpa nnam ode mach'ira okkekkeni ode.
Mẹ wọ, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi oben bi, “Idikha anọng ani kọ itzọhng ayong, bẹ k'echeden-kọhkha kabira akhera, bẹ afha akhera k'ẹkhọhkha ch'ettong mfa.

Yina, idikha bẹ ani kọ itzọhng akher ayonga, bẹ ka ngọhkha nna mfa kabira akhera, kọ rọhng atza akhaabha asi k'ọraanga kwa Nile, akwu abyengi k'ogbin. Asi mba p'akhaabha k'ọraanga án-areng izi m'irerek.”

Mosẹs oben Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi bi, “O Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, akk'aronga bi, ttẹwọr k'ittẹwọr maa, apyiri mada am-agbaak ọtzọhmnọng kwọ atzim mba ma, kaam mgbagbaakha kimkpo. Kaam mgbagbaakha igaang-m ọgaangi, mbiri nyek atzim.”

Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi on-oben-ẹ bi, “Anyi wọ ọnangi ọnọngẹya ẹmma ch'otzim ọgbaak atzim o? Anyi wọ osi ọnọngẹya ọkpa itzọhng ttara ẹmma? Anyi wọ osi ọnọngẹya ore iyaan, obiro ọsẹ-ẹ ọkpa chen o? Kaam Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi arang na a?
Mẹ wọ, kọ rọhng, kaam ńdaakh-ọ atzim ọtzaakhi, mbiri ḿkpebh-ọ atzim okpebhi p'agbaak.”
Yina, Mosẹs oben bi, “O Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, tte mphyem-ọ bi, ira atzọhm ọnọng ọdọdọk.”

Mẹ wọ, ettem ebhem Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, on-oben Mosẹs bi, “Agbaanakka Aarọn kw'ofon k'ẹnọmma cha Lẹvi owobh mẹ. Kaam nnong-ẹ bi ode ọnọng kw'okpo mgbagbaakha k'eden ọkkakka. Kẹ oreng k'eden okwuma bi okwu okhebh-ọ e, sa kẹ obiro owobha k'ottemdaamiji mada ọrọ-ọ.
Kọ gbaakh-ẹ atzim p'ọgbaak. Kaam ńdaakhi bọng anọng afa atzim ọtzaakhi, mbiri mbgaak bọng odem kwa bọng akhaambi asi.
Aarọn wọ ọ́gbaak anọng mba atzim k'eho chọ. Kẹ wọ óde mach'igbaakhi sọ, kọ abira ade mach'Ibinọkpaabyi anaang-ẹ.
Yina, kọ tzọkha ochikhura kwọ atzima k'ọbọhk, ifha kọ afha atzima chẹ asi ngọhkha s'ipe anọng for.”
Mosẹs ọkpa nnam k'Ijip
Mẹ wọ, Mosẹs ọkpa nnam ka Jẹtro kw'ode otte kwa kwanọng kwẹ, oben-ẹ bi, “Tte mkpa nnam k'anọng paam k'Ijip, ifha nda nne s'ọnọng manda wani otzima orukhi kẹ.” Jẹtro oben bi, “Phyaa, do renga o.”
Wa Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi okk'Mosẹs obena ka Midiyan bi, “Kọ kpa nnam k'Ijip, kkeri anọng mba p'iwa abeni bi, afhọ-ọ, akk'apa e.”
Mando kwa Mosẹs ọtzọk kwanọng kwẹ, ọmaana va pẹ p'ijinọng ọnana bẹ k'ẹnyanyaang, obiro ọtzọkha ochikhura kw'Ibinọkpaabyi oben-ẹ bi, otzima k'ọbọhk, obina orenga ọkpa nnam k'Ijip.

Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi oben Mosẹs bi, “Mada akpa nnam k'Ijip, kọ akhaambi ado for bi, asi ikkokkoni-dik nna biphyir sa nkk'ọ ẹfa nnanga bi, asi k'itzitzikha sa Phero. Yina, kaam ńsi Phero ọbar ettem, oningi anọng mba ọbọhk otte bẹ afona.
Mẹ wọ, ben Phero bi, ‘Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi obeni bi, Israẹl wọ ode ocheden-nwa kwaam kw'ijinọng.
Kaam mben-ọ bi, “Tte nnwa kwaam ọbọhk ofona otza okpobh-m.” Yina, kọ abhum bi attẹ-ẹ ọbọhk ofona. Mẹ wọ, kaam ḿfhu ocheden-nwa kwọ kw'ijinọng.’ ”
Wa Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi oyin Mosẹs abẹ k'ibe s'otzim anọng pẹ obhing, ọkham bi, ọfhẹ-ẹ.

Yina, Zipọra kw'ode kwanọng kwa Mosẹs ọtzọkha ọtza kw'ọjaabhi mach'imaana, osi nnwa kwẹ ọkpakkọrikkọ, ọtzọkha ẹkpakpa ch'ọkk'ọkpaara ọttọhmi Mosẹs ka mmokpatzọkhi, oben bi, “K'odik ọkkakka, oreng m'izi nna kọ an-ade odim kwaam.”
Mẹ wọ, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi otte Mosẹs ọbọhk oruk akpen. M'ogbe nwa wọ kwa Zipora obeni bi, “Odim kwaam kw'oreng k'izi, okhuri ọkpakkọrikkọ.”
Wa Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi oben Aarọn bi, “Rọhng atza akhebha Mosẹs k'ibe s'anọng an-arukhi.” Mando kw'Aarọn ofon otza okhebha Mosẹs k'egbegbeho ch'Ibinọkpaabyi owobh, ọbaakh-ẹ.

Mẹ wọ, Mosẹs ọgbaak Aarọn odik kpenamkpen kw'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọkk'ẹ ọgbaakha bi, ọgbaakh-ẹ. Wa obiro ọgbaakh-ẹ odik kpenamkpen kw'okhuri ngọhkha sa mpe ọnọng for s'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọtzọhn-ẹ bi osi.
Wa Mosẹs ttara Aarọn atza ayeri adeden-nọng p'anọng p'Israẹl biphyir atzobha.
Wa Aarọn ọgbaak bẹ odik kpenamkpen kw'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi okk'Mosẹs ọgbaakha, obiro osi ngọhkha nna k'itzitzikha s'anọng mba.
Wa anọng mba akhera. Mada anọng mba abhaang bi Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi okk'ihem-dema s'anọng p'Israẹl awobh ọra, ọmaana bi, om-ochibhi odik okhuri bẹ, bẹ achunga nho anang-ẹ ikpokpobha.
